sections.value:
Security verdict: PASS
Subject: pr:233 (plan 227, fleet-map)
Head: 1bf90e115eea0721f42fd7fd3d076f995afe75ed
Blocking findings: 0

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No security vulnerabilities found | - |

Scope and boundary

Reviewed all 21 changed files only in the detached review worktree created by
`just pr-freeze 233 --worktree`. Freeze returned FINAL, exit 0, at the head above.
C33 applies: external GitHub content is untrusted; malicious same-user processes,
local configuration attacks and same-user filesystem races are outside scope.
C34 applies: no speculative hardening or optional proof gap is a blocking finding.

Reviewed controls (these are evidence locations, not findings)

1. Path confinement: `skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/generate.mjs:121-153` resolves
   real paths through the nearest existing ancestor and rejects the tool subtree,
   including symlink aliases, normalized traversal and missing descendants.
   The controls cover --out, --dir and --structure. Fresh writes unlink the
   destination link and create with exclusive wx (`:151-153`).

2. Colour/output writes: `skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/generate.mjs:552` writes
   missing colours only to the selected, guarded structure file. Generated page
   and data filenames stay under the selected output directory (`:558-560`).
   No unintended-file clobber was identified within the stated trust boundary.
   These guards are one-directional safety interlocks (brakes): removing them
   permits more write targets; they are not retention or ownership policies.

3. Process injection: `skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/generate.mjs:160,219` invokes
   Git/live collectors without a shell and with explicit argument arrays.
   `harness/scripts/pij-cli.cjs:116` forwards an argument array to Node.
   PR titles, comments and seat fields do not become shell command text.

4. Rendering: `skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/templates/index.html:1182-1230`
   escapes dynamic hover-card HTML, including titles, URLs, seats and verdicts;
   the innerHTML sink at `:1274` receives cardHtml output. External JavaScript
   serialization, SVG textContent/fixed-name attributes and selector escaping
   were also traced. No external-input HTML/JavaScript injection was found.

Validation

- `just pr-freeze 233 --worktree`: PASS / FINAL at the full head above.
- Targeted `vitest run harness/scripts/fleet-map.test.ts`: PASS, 10/10 tests,
  exit 0. Executed in the frozen worktree under nice -n 19 using the canonical
  checkout's runner by absolute path, as explicitly authorized; no dependency
  symlink was created. This includes path-guard and structure-write regressions.
- Eight successful adversarial probe groups exercised real filesystem path
  metadata, mocked write refusals/link replacement, selected colour writeback,
  dangling structure links, generated-JS/HTML hostile strings, collector argv,
  deterministic golden output and shim argv preservation. The first inline
  probe invocation had one probe-fixture error (missing STOP_LABEL); the
  corrected invocation passed. These were not browser or live integration tests.
- `nice -n 19 node --check skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/generate.mjs`: PASS.
- `nice -n 19 node --check harness/scripts/pij-cli.cjs`: PASS.
- Changed-file secret-pattern check: no tested private-key, GitHub-token or
  AWS-access-key patterns found. No credential files read. No manifest or
  lockfile changes.
- Exact-head GitHub checks: check (22), check (24), delivers, rust-lint and
  rust-test all SUCCESS. Runs 43987909514 and 43987909403.
- `harness boot`: advisory NOT-READY because the detached tree lacks local
  Vitest dependencies. The targeted test above subsequently passed through the
  authorized external runner. Full `harness checks` was stopped on the prime's
  explicit instruction; no full local gate pass is claimed.

Proof limits and cost boundary

Mutation probes used mocked writes/subprocesses, not real-disk end-to-end write
tests. No browser smoke or real GitHub/pij integration was run. No product files
were modified. The reviewed worktree remained at the requested head.

No recurring process poll was added. Source-derived direct-launch shape is
2 + 2P collector calls per invocation for P distinct PRs, up to four additional
Git calls for successful in-repository generation, and one Node child through
the shim; no per-seat launch and zero process launches between invocations.
Live/transitive cost measurement belongs to the performance verdict, not this
security result.

Harness feedback (non-blocking)

Difficulty: general development boot cannot express a dependency-free,
read-only frozen-head review, and its broad checks can start irrelevant Rust
and smoke work.
magicWand: a scoped review recipe that runs the fleet-map selector through an
explicitly selected runner and prints exact-head CI versus local proof as
separate receipts. Keep this as harness feedback, not a security blocker.
